name: ZOOM Kindermuseum
notes: Site has no central calendar; each program section (Ausstellung, Atelier, Ozean, Trickfilmstudio, Fragwuerdig/Kindervorlesungen) has one standing page describing whatever is currently on offer, parsed as a permanent record (extra.permanent=true). A couple of subpages (e.g. atelier-abos) carry a structured 'Laufzeit:' range or 'TERMINE' list of single dated slots, which become discrete dated occurrences instead. Server is very flaky/slow (JSESSIONID redirect dance, frequent multi-minute hangs on some requests) so scrape.py uses its own cookie-jar opener; fetch_page now retries each hub page up to 3x with backoff (2s/4s) at a 15s per-attempt timeout and, if a page still doesn't answer, raises RuntimeError instead of silently skipping it - a hang can no longer masquerade as 'the museum just has fewer events this week'. A failed run means scrape.py exits non-zero and no partial/truncated record set is ever emitted as if it were complete.
